_comment: Synthetic negative-case data. Real credentials are never stored here — a null login_id/password means 'use FE_USERNAME_<SUB>/FE_PASSWORD_<SUB> from .env.<env>'. See lib/app/modules/purchase_checker/login/PLAN.md.
name: S1_overlong_login_id
description: 303-character login id; must be rejected cleanly rather than erroring.

expected._comment: Only what the BE cannot tell us. Identity and session shape come from LoginResult. error_message is the locale-specific text the FE renders; null means assert only that the login was rejected.
